+import {tryWeakTuningHit} from './weak-tuning.js';
+import {tryNeutralizationHit} from './neutralization-tuning.js';
+import {shareTargetTuningDamage} from './target-tuning.js';
+import {tryRepairTuningHit} from './repair-tuning.js';
+import {tryLuxeryTuningHit} from './luxery-tuning.js';
+import {coldTuningSettings,tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
+import {applyFrozen} from './frozen-status.js';
+import {damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
+/** Starting-weapon on-hit effect; its own cold damage cannot trigger another proc. */
+export function tryColdTuningHit({player,enemy,rollDamage,random=Math.random,weaponId='plana-umbrella'}){
+  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
+  if(main!==weaponId||!player.tuningParts||enemy.hp<=0||enemy.frozenRemaining>0)return false;
+  const percent=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'coldDamagePercent');
+  if(!percent||(enemy.secondsSincePlayerHit||0)<coldTuningSettings.safeSeconds||random()>=coldTuningSettings.procChance)return false;
+  if(!applyFrozen(enemy,coldTuningSettings.freezeSeconds))return false;
+  const hit=rollDamage(enemy,percent/100);
+  const hpBefore=enemy.hp;
+  const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{coldTuning:true});
+  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'weakChance')>0)tryWeakTuningHit({player,enemy});
+  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'stunChance')>0)tryNeutralizationHit({player,enemy});
+  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'targetPercent')>0)shareTargetTuningDamage({player,enemy,damage:Math.min(hpBefore,hit.damage),hitType:hit.type});
+  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'repairMaxHpPercent')>0)tryRepairTuningHit({player});
+  if(landed&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'creditChancePercent')>0)tryLuxeryTuningHit({player,enemy,damage:hit.damage});
+  return true;
+}

+import { crafterSettings, crafterEnhancementCost, crafterEnhancementChance, umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings } from './game-config.js';

+/** List only equipped targets, keeping upgrades capped and offering only defined awakening paths. */
+export function crafterChoices(player) {
+  const choices=[],loot=getLootTotals();
+  for(const [kind,slots] of [['weapon',player.attackSlots||[]],['item',player.equipmentSlots||[]]]) {
+    slots.forEach((target,index)=>{
+      if(!target)return;
+      const max=target.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
+        target.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:target.maxLevel;
+      if(!Number.isFinite(max))return;
+      const prefix=`${kind}:${index}`,name=target.name||target.id||'Item',level=target.level||1;
+      if(!target.isSynergy&&level<max)choices.push({id:`${prefix}:level`,target,kind,name,label:`Upgrade to LV ${level+1}`,cost:0,disabled:false});
+      else if(kind==='weapon') {
+        const rank=(target.enhancementRank||0)+1,cost=crafterEnhancementCost(rank);
+        const chance=crafterEnhancementChance(rank,player.enhancementRateBonusPercent||0);
+        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:enhance`,target,kind,name,label:`Enhance +${rank} — ${cost} Credits — ${Math.round(chance*100)}% success`,cost,chance,rank,disabled:loot.credits<cost});
+      }
+      if(kind==='item'&&target.id==='malkuth-hat'&&level>=max&&!target.awakened)
+        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:'Awaken - 1 Secret Tech Note',disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<1});
+      const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
+      if(kind==='weapon'&&target.id==='plana-umbrella'&&main===target.id&&level>=max&&!target.awakened) {
+        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:`Awaken — ${umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost} Secret Tech Note`,disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost});
+      }
+    });
+  }
+  return choices;
+}
+
+/** A valid attempt consumes one Crafter even when a paid enhancement fails. */
+export function applyCrafterChoice(player,id,random=Math.random) {
+  const choice=crafterChoices(player).find(c=>c.id===id);
+  if(!choice||choice.disabled)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'That upgrade is unavailable.'};
+  const action=id.split(':').at(-1),target=choice.target;
+  if(action==='level') {target.level=(target.level||1)+1;if(choice.kind==='weapon')recordWeaponMax(player,target);return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} upgraded to LV ${target.level}.`};}
+  if(action==='awaken') {
+    if(!spendSecretTechNotes(choice.kind==='item'?1:umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
+    if(choice.kind==='item')Object.assign(target,createMalkuthHat(true));
+    target.awakened=true;return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} awakened!`};
+  }
+  if(!spendCredits(choice.cost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
+  const success=random()<choice.chance;
+  if(success)target.enhancementRank=choice.rank;
+  return {consumed:true,success,message:success?`${choice.name} enhanced to +${choice.rank}!`:`Enhancement failed. ${choice.cost} Credits and the Crafter were consumed.`};
+}

+/** Three primary blue shots per cycle, each paired with one secondary pink shot. */
+export function createDecagrammatonAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
+  let bullets=[],owner=null,cooldown=0,enabled=true,shots=0,shotIndex=0,gaps=[],exSpray=false;
+  const settings=decagrammatonSettings;
+  function reset(){bullets=[];owner=null;cooldown=0;shots=0;shotIndex=0;gaps=[];}
+  function update(delta,player,aim=0,viewport=null){
+    if(!player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='decagrammaton')){reset();return;}
+    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
+    if(delta<=0)return;
+    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
+    let left=delta;
+    while(left>1e-8){
+      const enemies=getAllEnemies();
+      if(enabled&&!exSpray&&cooldown<=1e-8){
+        if(shotIndex===0){
+          const weights=Array.from({length:settings.attackCount*2},()=>.7+random()*.6);
+          const total=weights.reduce((sum,value)=>sum+value,0);
+          gaps=weights.map(value=>settings.interval*value/total);
+        }
+        cooldown=gaps[shotIndex];

+        // Choose among targets near the aim line as well as surrounding enemies.
+        const aimed=candidates.slice().sort((a,b)=>{
+          const score=e=>{const p=getEnemyHurtbox(e);return Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(p.y-body.y,p.x-body.x)-aim),Math.cos(Math.atan2(p.y-body.y,p.x-body.x)-aim)));};
+          return score(a)-score(b);
+        })[0];
+        {
+          const target=shotIndex===0?aimed:candidates[Math.min(candidates.length-1,Math.floor(random()*candidates.length))];
+          {
+            const color=shotIndex%2===0?'blue':'pink';
+            const spec=settings[color],targetBody=color==='blue'&&target?getEnemyHurtbox(target):null;
+            // Resolve the actual firing direction before placing the muzzle on the player's edge.
+            const launchAim=targetBody&&Math.hypot(targetBody.x-body.x,targetBody.y-body.y)>1e-8
+              ?Math.atan2(targetBody.y-body.y,targetBody.x-body.x):aim;
+            const angle=launchAim+(random()-.5)*12*Math.PI/180;
+            const combatDiameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter*spec.area*(spec.sizeScale??1)*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
+            const diameter=combatDiameter;
+            const offset=1/Math.hypot(Math.cos(angle)/body.rx,Math.sin(angle)/body.ry)+luminousNovaSettings.muzzleGap+diameter/2*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale;
+            bullets.push({x:body.x+Math.cos(angle)*offset,y:body.y+Math.sin(angle)*offset,angle,color,diameter,combatDiameter,fadeOutSeconds:spec.fadeOutSeconds,
+              target:color==='blue'?target?.id:null,orbit:random()*Math.PI*2,age:0,speed:settings.speed,trailSpeed:luminousNovaSettings.projectileSpeed*(color==='blue'?diameter/luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter:1),accelerating:color!=='blue',hits:new Map(),hitCount:0});shots++;
+          }
+        }
+      shotIndex=(shotIndex+1)%(settings.attackCount*2);
+      }
+      const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&!exSpray&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);left-=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
+      const index=createEnemySpatialIndex(enemies,getEnemyHurtbox);
+      for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){

+        const target=b.target?getEnemy(b.target):null;
+        // A lost target releases homing; keep the last heading for the remaining lifetime.
+        if(b.target&&(!target||target.hp<=0))b.target=null;
+        if(target&&b.target){
+          const t=getEnemyHurtbox(target),radius=Math.max(t.rx,t.ry)*.65*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
+          const near=Math.hypot(b.x-t.x,b.y-t.y)<radius+settings.speed*step*2;

+            b.angle=Math.atan2(y-b.y,x-b.x);b.x=x;b.y=y;
+          }else {b.angle=Math.atan2(t.y-b.y,t.x-b.x);b.x+=Math.cos(b.angle)*settings.speed*step;b.y+=Math.sin(b.angle)*settings.speed*step;}

+        if(b.color==='blue')rememberPlasmaTrail(b,from,b.diameter/2*(1+luminousNovaSettings.trailLengthRatio));
+        for(const enemy of index.querySegment(from,b,b.combatDiameter*1.8)){
+          if(b.hitCount>=spec.hitLimit)break;
+          if(b.age-(b.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<spec.hitCooldown||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,b,b.combatDiameter*1.8))continue;
+          b.hits.set(enemy.id,b.age);b.hitCount++;
+          const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'decagrammaton',spec.damage,[],{projectileCount:settings.attackCount,hitCooldownFrames:spec.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy});
+          const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,damageGroup:'decagrammaton'}),living=getEnemy(enemy.id);

+        }
+        if(b.age>=spec.duration||b.hitCount>=spec.hitLimit)bullets.splice(i,1);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),update,reset,draw(context,camera){for(const b of bullets)drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,b,b.diameter,decagrammatonSettings[b.color].duration);},
+    setExMode(active,shooting){exSpray=Boolean(active&&shooting);},
+    setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;},get shotsFired(){return shots;}};

+// Settings survive an identified development-server reload, never an ordinary refresh.
+(() => {
+  const key = `orbitrail:dev-settings:${location.pathname}`;
+  const marker = `${key}:code-reload`;
+  const read = name => { try { return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(name)); } catch { return null; } };
+  const write = (name, value) => { try { sessionStorage.setItem(name, JSON.stringify(value)); } catch {} };
+  const remove = name => { try { sessionStorage.removeItem(name); } catch {} };
+  const signal = read(marker);
+  const saved = signal && Date.now() - signal < 15000 ? read(key) : null;
+  remove(marker);
+  if (!saved) remove(key);
+  const selector = '.test-toolbar input, .test-toolbar select, .admin-panel input, .admin-panel select, #admin-clock-form input';
+  const controls = () => [...document.querySelectorAll(selector)].filter(el => !el.disabled && !['file','password'].includes(el.type) && el.name !== 'npc-selection');
+  const identity = el => el.id ? `id:${el.id}` : `name:${el.name}`;
+  const buttons = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-character], #toggle-bounds, #toggle-arrow, #music-soundtrack-toggle, #music-toggle, #toggle-random-spawning')];
+  const buttonKey = el => el.id || `character:${el.dataset.character}`;
+  function snapshot() {
+    return {
+      statDefaultsVersion: 1,
+      controls: Object.fromEntries(controls().map(el => [identity(el), {value:el.value, checked:el.checked}])),
+      buttons: Object.fromEntries(buttons().map(el => [buttonKey(el), el.getAttribute('aria-pressed')])),
+      panels: [...document.querySelectorAll('details.admin-panel, #npc-tools, #player-stats-panel')].map(el => ({id:el.id, index:[...document.querySelectorAll('details')].indexOf(el), open:el.open})),
+      adminOpen: !document.querySelector('#admin-panel')?.hidden
+    };
+  }
+  // Register before Live Server's handler, so the snapshot is written before reload().
+  const NativeSocket = window.WebSocket;
+  if (NativeSocket) window.WebSocket = class extends NativeSocket {
+    constructor(...args) {
+      super(...args);
+      this.addEventListener('message', event => {
+        let message; try { message = JSON.parse(event.data); } catch {}
+        if (event.data === 'reload' || message?.type === 'full-reload') {
+          write(key, snapshot()); write(marker, Date.now());
+        }
+      });
+    }
+  };
+  let restoring = false;
+  for (const event of ['input','change','click','toggle']) document.addEventListener(event, () => {
+    if (!restoring) write(key, snapshot());
+  }, true);
+  window.restoreDevSession = () => {
+    if (!saved) return;
+    restoring = true;
+    try {
+      // Select the avatar first, then apply settings through their existing handlers.
+      for (const el of buttons()) {
+        const target = saved.buttons?.[buttonKey(el)];
+        if (target != null && target !== el.getAttribute('aria-pressed') && (!el.dataset.character || target === 'true')) el.click();
+      }
+      for (const el of controls()) {
+        const state = saved.controls?.[identity(el)];
+        if (!state) continue;
+        // Older snapshots stored the former generic zero CRT, before character defaults.
+        if(!saved.statDefaultsVersion&&el.dataset?.combatStat==='critPercent')continue;
+        if (el.tagName === 'SELECT' && ![...el.options].some(option => option.value === state.value)) continue;
+        el.value = state.value;
+        if (el.type === 'checkbox' || el.type === 'radio') el.checked = state.checked;
+        el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true}));
+        el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true}));
+      }
+      for (const panel of saved.panels || []) {
+        const el = panel.id ? document.getElementById(panel.id) : document.querySelectorAll('details')[panel.index];
+        if (el) el.open = panel.open;
+      }
+      const admin = document.querySelector('#admin-panel');
+      if (admin && !admin.hidden !== saved.adminOpen) document.querySelector('#admin-tools').click();
+    } finally { restoring = false; write(key, snapshot()); }
+  };
+})();

+/** Equipment definitions and account-local content unlocks. Guest unlocks stay in memory. */
+let itemUnlockStore=null,itemUnlockKey=null;
+const unlockedItems=new Set();
+let developerUnlocks=false,simulateAccount=false;
+const simulatedUnlocks=new Set();
+/** Developer bypass never writes unlocks; simulation is a separate fresh test profile. */
+export function setUnlockSimulation(enabled){
+  const next=developerUnlocks&&Boolean(enabled);
+  if(next&&!simulateAccount)simulatedUnlocks.clear();
+  simulateAccount=next;
+}
+export function isUnlockSimulation(){return simulateAccount;}
+export function isContentUnlocked(id,defaultUnlocked=false){
+  return (developerUnlocks&&!simulateAccount)||defaultUnlocked||(simulateAccount?simulatedUnlocks:unlockedItems).has(id);
+}
+export function unlockContent(id){
+  if(simulateAccount){simulatedUnlocks.add(id);return;}
+  unlockedItems.add(id);
+  try {itemUnlockStore?.setItem(itemUnlockKey,JSON.stringify([...unlockedItems]));} catch {}
+}
+/** Called only for actual boss defeats; normal enemies cannot satisfy this objective. */
+export function unlockStageBossRewards(stage,bossType){
+  if(stage===1&&bossType==='shiroko')unlockContent('saint-predator');
+  if(stage===2&&bossType==='arisu')unlockContent('aris-laser');
+}

+import { weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
+import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
+import {applySkillControl} from './enemy-control.js';
+export function knockbackTuningMultiplier(player){
+  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
+  return main==='plana-umbrella'&&player.tuningParts?1+tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackStrengthPercent')/100:1;
+}
+export function applyTuningKnockback(player,enemy){
+  if(!enemy||enemy.hp<=0||!player.tuningParts||knockbackTuningMultiplier(player)===1)return false;
+  const frames=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackFrames'),speed=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackSpeed');
+  if(!frames||!speed)return false;
+  const dx=enemy.x-player.x,dy=enemy.y-player.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy),distance=speed*frames*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
+  applySkillControl(enemy,(length?dx/length:1)*distance,(length?dy/length:0)*distance,0,frames/60);
+  return true;
+}

+import { isContentUnlocked } from './item-catalog.js';
+const limits={reroll:10,eliminate:10,hold:5};
+export function levelActionUses(player,action){
+  const purchased=Math.max(0,Math.min(limits[action],Math.trunc(Number(player.abilityUpgradeRanks?.[action])||0)));
+  const granted=isContentUnlocked('developer-level-actions')?limits[action]:purchased;
+  return Math.max(0,granted-(player.levelActionSpent?.[action]||0));
+}
+export function spendLevelAction(player,action){
+  if(!levelActionUses(player,action))return false;
+  player.levelActionSpent??={};player.levelActionSpent[action]=(player.levelActionSpent[action]||0)+1;return true;
+}
+export function levelActionChoices(player,pool,random=Math.random){
+  const remaining=pool.slice(),choices=[];
+  while(remaining.length){
+    const weight=choice=>Math.max(0,Number(choice.weapon?.weight??1)||0),total=remaining.reduce((sum,c)=>sum+weight(c),0);
+    let roll=random()*total,index=remaining.length-1;
+    for(let i=0;i<remaining.length;i++){roll-=weight(remaining[i]);if(roll<0){index=i;break;}}
+    choices.push(...remaining.splice(index,1));
+  }
+  const held=choices.findIndex(choice=>choice.id===player.heldUpgradeId);
+  if(held>=0)choices.unshift(...choices.splice(held,1));
+  return choices;
+}

+export function updateLifeJacket(player,delta){
+ syncLifeJacketShield(player);const stats=lifeJacketStats(player),state=player.lifeJacketState;
+ if(!stats||!state||!(delta>0))return;
+ let left=delta;
+ while(left>1e-8){
+  const full=state.remaining>=state.capacity-1e-8;
+  if(!full||!stats.super)state.healElapsed=0;
+  const step=Math.min(left,15-state.refreshElapsed,stats.super&&full?3-state.healElapsed:Infinity);
+  left-=step;state.refreshElapsed+=step;if(stats.super&&full)state.healElapsed+=step;

+  if(stats.super&&full&&state.healElapsed>=3-1e-8){player.hp=Math.min(player.maxHp,player.hp+10);state.healElapsed=0;}

+/** Convert actual traveled positions to the plasma head's local coordinates, newest first. */
+export function plasmaTrailPoints(bullet,maxLength) {
+  if(!(bullet.trail?.length>1)||!(maxLength>1e-8))return null;
+  const points=[{x:0,y:0,distance:0}],cos=Math.cos(bullet.angle),sin=Math.sin(bullet.angle);
+  let previous={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y},distance=0;
+  for(let i=bullet.trail.length-1;i>=0;i--){

+    const fraction=Math.min(1,(maxLength-distance)/length),x=previous.x+(p.x-previous.x)*fraction,y=previous.y+(p.y-previous.y)*fraction;
+    distance+=length*fraction;const dx=x-bullet.x,dy=y-bullet.y;
+    points.push({x:dx*cos+dy*sin,y:-dx*sin+dy*cos,distance});
+    if(fraction<1||distance>=maxLength)break;previous=p;
+  }
+  return points.length>1?points:null;

+import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
+import { molotovSettings, molotovLevelStats, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
+import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
+import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale } from './tuning-parts.js';
+import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
+import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
+import { molotovAnimationReady, drawMolotovNapalm } from './molotov-animation.js';
+
+/** Explicit fallback odds: 30% close, 60% middle, 10% far; randomized within each band. */
+export function molotovThrowDistance(random=Math.random){
+ const u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,random()));
+ if(u<.3)return .05+.25*(u/.3);
+ if(u<.9)return .3+.4*((u-.3)/.6);
+ return .7+.3*((u-.9)/.1);
+}
+
+/** Prefer the nearest enemy in the middle 30-80% of directional screen reach. */
+export function molotovLandingPoint(body,view,enemies,random=Math.random){
+ const pad=Math.max(view.width,view.height)*.15;
+ function reach(angle){const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
+  const edgeX=Math.abs(dx)>1e-8?((dx>0?view.x+view.width+pad:view.x-pad)-body.x)/dx:Infinity;
+  const edgeY=Math.abs(dy)>1e-8?((dy>0?view.y+view.height+pad:view.y-pad)-body.y)/dy:Infinity;
+  return Math.max(20,Math.min(edgeX,edgeY));
+ }
+ let nearest=null,nearestDistance=Infinity;
+ for(const enemy of enemies){
+  const target=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=target.x-body.x,dy=target.y-body.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
+  const fraction=distance/reach(Math.atan2(dy,dx));
+  if(fraction>=.3&&fraction<=.8&&distance<nearestDistance){nearest=target;nearestDistance=distance;}
+ }
+ if(nearest)return {x:nearest.x,y:nearest.y};
+ const angle=random()*Math.PI*2,distance=reach(angle)*molotovThrowDistance(random);
+ return {x:body.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance,y:body.y+Math.sin(angle)*distance};
+}
+
+export function createMolotovAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
+ let owner=null,cooldown=0,time=0,enabled=true,throws=[],fires=[],shots=0;
+ function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;throws=[];fires=[];shots=0;}
+ function launch(player,stats,viewport){
+  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
+  const enemies=getAllEnemies();
+  for(let i=0;i<stats.count;i++){
+   const {x,y}=molotovLandingPoint(body,view,enemies,random);
+   throws.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,fromX:body.x,fromY:body.y,toX:x,toY:y,age:0,
+    flight:Math.max(.12,Math.hypot(x-body.x,y-body.y)/molotovSettings.speed),
+    radius:stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),duration:stats.duration,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,count:stats.count});shots++;
+  }
+ }
+ function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
+  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='molotov-cocktail');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
+  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(delta<=0)return;
+  let left=delta;
+  while(left>1e-8){
+   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){launch(player,molotovLevelStats(weapon.level),viewport);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(molotovSettings.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
+   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);left-=step;time+=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
+   for(let i=throws.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=throws[i];b.age+=step;const progress=Math.min(1,b.age/b.flight);b.x=b.fromX+(b.toX-b.fromX)*progress;b.y=b.fromY+(b.toY-b.fromY)*progress;
+    if(progress>=1){fires.push({...b,x:b.toX,y:b.toY,age:0,hits:new Map()});throws.splice(i,1);}}
+   const enemies=getAllEnemies(),living=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));
+   for(let i=fires.length-1;i>=0;i--){const zone=fires[i];zone.age+=step;
+    if(zone.age>=zone.duration){fires.splice(i,1);continue;}
+    for(const id of zone.hits.keys())if(!living.has(id))zone.hits.delete(id);
+    for(const enemy of enemies){if(time-(zone.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<molotovSettings.hitCooldown-1e-8)continue;
+     const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=t.x-zone.x,dy=t.y-zone.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/t.rx,dy/distance/t.ry):0;
+     if(distance>zone.radius+extent)continue;zone.hits.set(enemy.id,time);
+     const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'molotov-cocktail',molotovSettings.damage,zone.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:zone.count,hitCooldownFrames:45}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'molotov-cocktail'});
+     damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
+    }
+   }
+  }
+ }
+ function drawGround(context,camera){for(const zone of fires)drawMolotovNapalm(context,camera,zone);}
+ function drawThrows(context,camera){context.save();for(const b of throws){const arc=Math.sin(Math.PI*b.age/b.flight)*45;
+  context.save();context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y-arc);context.rotate(b.age*7);context.fillStyle='#746533';context.fillRect(-4,-7,8,14);context.fillStyle='#d3cca5';context.fillRect(-2,-11,4,5);context.fillStyle='#ffb64d';context.fillRect(-2,-14,4,4);context.restore();}context.restore();}
+ return {ready:molotovAnimationReady,reset,update,drawGround,drawThrows,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get fireCount(){return fires.length;},get projectileCount(){return throws.length;}};
+}

diff --git a/Development/neutralization-tuning.js b/Development/neutralization-tuning.js
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..ea378505
--- /dev/null
+++ b/Development/neutralization-tuning.js
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
+const attempts=new WeakMap();let clock=0;
+export function updateNeutralizationTuning(delta){clock+=Math.max(0,delta);}
+function enabled(player){return player.tuningParts&&(player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null))==='plana-umbrella';}
+export function tryNeutralizationHit({player,enemy,random=Math.random}){
+  if(!enabled(player)||enemy.hp<=0)return false;
+  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'stunChance');if(!chance||random()>=chance)return false;
+  enemy.stunRemaining=Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining||0,1);enemy.moving=false;return true;
+}
+export function canEraseEnemyProjectile(projectile){
+  return projectile.erasable!==false&&!['neru','iroha'].includes(projectile.ownerType)&&
+    !['ground-pound','smash','ram','self-destruct','explosion'].includes(projectile.kind);
+}
+/** The whole attack shares one attempt per second, on success or failure. */
+export function eraseTuningProjectiles({player,attack,projectiles,intersects,random=Math.random}){
+  if(!enabled(player)||clock-(attempts.get(attack)??-Infinity)<1-1e-8)return false;
+  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'eraseChance');if(!chance)return false;
+  for(let i=0;i<projectiles.length;i++){
+    if(!canEraseEnemyProjectile(projectiles[i])||!intersects(projectiles[i]))continue;
+    attempts.set(attack,clock);if(random()>=chance)return false;
+    projectiles.splice(i,1);return true;
+  }return false;
+}

+import { overclockingStats, itemHpDrainNegated, syncLifeJacketShield } from './item-catalog.js';
+/** HP loss, never a hit: bypasses shields except the explicitly enabled Luminous/Life Jacket pair. */
+export function updateOverclocking(player,delta){
+ const stats=overclockingStats(player);
+ if(!stats.drainPercent||itemHpDrainNegated(player)){player.overclockDrainElapsed=0;return;}
+ if(!(delta>0)||!Number.isFinite(delta))return;
+ player.overclockDrainElapsed=(player.overclockDrainElapsed||0)+delta;
+ while(player.overclockDrainElapsed>=1-1e-8){
+  player.overclockDrainElapsed-=1;
+  let loss=player.maxHp*stats.drainPercent/100;
+  if(player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='luminous-nova')&&player.equipmentSlots?.some(i=>i?.id==='life-jacket')){
+   syncLifeJacketShield(player);const state=player.lifeJacketState;
+   const absorbed=Math.min(state?.remaining||0,loss);if(state){state.remaining-=absorbed;if(state.remaining<state.capacity)state.healElapsed=0;}loss-=absorbed;
+   const shield=Math.min(Math.max(0,player.shield||0),loss);player.shield=(player.shield||0)-shield;loss-=shield;
+  }
+  if(player.hp>1)player.hp=Math.max(1,player.hp-loss);
+ }
+}

diff --git a/Development/pickup-reentry.js b/Development/pickup-reentry.js

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+/** Per-pickup protection after leaving a menu. Timers advance only on game time. */
+export function createPickupReentryGuard(delay=1.5) {
+  const blocks=new Map();
+  return {
+    block(key){blocks.set(key,{waitingToLeave:true,remaining:delay});},
+    blocked(key,touching,delta=0){
+      const state=blocks.get(key);if(!state)return false;
+      if(touching){state.waitingToLeave=true;state.remaining=delay;return true;}
+      // The first fully separated frame starts the delay; time spent overlapping never counts.
+      if(state.waitingToLeave){state.waitingToLeave=false;return true;}
+      state.remaining=Math.max(0,state.remaining-Math.max(0,Number.isFinite(delta)?delta:0));
+      if(state.remaining>1e-8)return true;
+      blocks.delete(key);return false;
+    },
+    forget(key){blocks.delete(key);},
+    clear(){blocks.clear();}
+  };
+}

+/** Two-second eligibility window, recorded before a lethal hit dispatches defeat listeners. */
+export function recordRateUpHit(enemy,chance){
+  if(!(chance>0))return false;
+  enemy.rateUpHitAge=0;enemy.rateUpChance=chance;return true;
+}
+export function updateRateUpWindow(enemy,delta){
+  if(enemy.rateUpHitAge!==undefined)enemy.rateUpHitAge+=Math.max(0,delta);
+}
+export function rateUpRollSucceeds(enemy,random=Math.random){
+  return enemy.rateUpHitAge!==undefined&&enemy.rateUpHitAge<=2&&enemy.rateUpChance>0&&random()<enemy.rateUpChance;
+}

+export function rateUpDropChance(enemy){
+  return enemy.rateUpHitAge!==undefined&&enemy.rateUpHitAge<=2?enemy.rateUpChance||0:0;

+import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
+import {healPlayer} from './player-stats.js';
+export const repairTuningSettings={chance:.15,interval:1};
+export function updateRepairTuning(player,delta){
+  if(player.tuningParts)player.tuningParts.repairCooldown=Math.max(0,(player.tuningParts.repairCooldown||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
+}
+/** Independent healing, not life-steal: no dependency on hit damage or life-steal effects. */
+export function tryRepairTuningHit({player,random=Math.random,weaponId='plana-umbrella'}){
+  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null),run=player.tuningParts;
+  if(main!==weaponId||!run||run.repairCooldown>1e-8||player.hp>=player.maxHp)return false;
+  const percent=tuningPerk(run,'repairMaxHpPercent'),cap=Math.floor(player.maxHp*percent/100);
+  if(cap<1)return false;
+  run.repairCooldown=repairTuningSettings.interval;
+  if(random()>=repairTuningSettings.chance)return false;
+  const amount=1+Math.min(cap-1,Math.floor(random()*cap));healPlayer(player,amount);return amount;
+}

+import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
+export function rgbTuningActive(player,weaponId='plana-umbrella'){
+  return Boolean(player.tuningParts&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'rainbowTrail'));
+}
+export function rainbowTrailGradient(context,x1,y1,x2,y2){
+  const gradient=context.createLinearGradient(x1,y1,x2,y2);
+  ['#ff6090','#ffad57','#fff178','#73f7a7','#66e5ff','#9292ff','#ec80ff'].forEach((color,i)=>gradient.addColorStop(i/6,color));
+  return gradient;
+}
+/** Tint only already drawn trail pixels; never recolor the world or the solid weapon. */
+export function tintRainbowTrail(context,width,height){
+  context.save();context.globalAlpha=1;context.globalCompositeOperation='source-atop';
+  context.fillStyle=rainbowTrailGradient(context,0,height,width,0);context.fillRect(0,0,width,height);context.restore();
+}
+
+/** Recolor plasma while retaining its alpha falloff and pale luminous highlights. */
+export function rainbowPlasmaColor(value,hue){
+  const palette=[[255,75,90],[255,190,55],[200,255,70],[55,255,150],[65,195,255],[180,95,255]];
+  const phase=((hue%360)+360)%360/60,index=Math.floor(phase),t=phase-index;
+  const color=palette[index].map((v,i)=>v+(palette[(index+1)%6][i]-v)*t);
+  const recolor=(r,g,b)=>{
+    const bright=Math.max(+r,+g,+b)/255,white=Math.max(0,(Math.min(+r,+g,+b)-180)/75)*.65;
+    return color.map(v=>Math.round((v*(1-white)+255*white)*bright));
+  };
+  if(value.startsWith('#'))return '#'+recolor(parseInt(value.slice(1,3),16),parseInt(value.slice(3,5),16),parseInt(value.slice(5,7),16)).map(v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')+value.slice(7);
+  return value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/,(_,prefix,r,g,b)=>prefix+recolor(r,g,b).join(','));
+}

+import { saintPredatorSettings, saintPredatorLevelStats, attackTimeFormula, weaponSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
+import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
+import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale, startingWeaponProjectileCount } from './tuning-parts.js';

+import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';

+/** One-hit missiles choose random visible targets, then retain their launch trajectory. */
+export function createSaintPredatorAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
+ let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,missiles=[],shots=0;
+ const s=saintPredatorSettings;
+ function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;missiles=[];shots=0;}
+ function fire(player,weapon,viewport){
+  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),stats=saintPredatorLevelStats(weapon.level),size=s.area*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
+  const view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
+  const targets=getAllEnemies().filter(e=>{const b=getEnemyHurtbox(e);return b.x+b.rx>=view.x&&b.x-b.rx<=view.x+view.width&&b.y+b.ry>=view.y&&b.y-b.ry<=view.y+view.height;});
+  const count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'saint-predator',stats.count);
+  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
+   const target=targets.length?targets[Math.min(targets.length-1,Math.floor(random()*targets.length))]:null,t=target?getEnemyHurtbox(target):null;
+   const angle=t?Math.atan2(t.y-body.y,t.x-body.x):random()*Math.PI*2,dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
+   const edge=1/Math.hypot(dx/body.rx,dy/body.ry)+s.radius*size+3;
+   missiles.push({x:body.x+dx*edge,y:body.y+dy*edge,angle,age:0,size,speed:stats.speed,count,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses});shots++;
+  }
+ }
+ function advance(delta,player){
+  const enemies=getAllEnemies(),index=createEnemySpatialIndex(enemies,getEnemyHurtbox);
+  for(let i=missiles.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=missiles[i],step=Math.min(delta,s.duration-b.age),from={x:b.x,y:b.y};
+   b.age+=step;b.x+=Math.cos(b.angle)*b.speed*step;b.y+=Math.sin(b.angle)*b.speed*step;
+   const radius=s.radius*b.size;
+   // Closest swept hit wins; each missile can deal damage to only one enemy.
+   const candidates=index.querySegment(from,b,radius).filter(enemy=>{if(!getEnemy(enemy.id))return false;const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return segmentHitsBody({...t,rx:t.rx+radius,ry:t.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,b.x,b.y);});
+   candidates.sort((a,c)=>{const t=getEnemyHurtbox(a),u=getEnemyHurtbox(c);return Math.hypot(t.x-from.x,t.y-from.y)-Math.hypot(u.x-from.x,u.y-from.y);});
+   if(candidates.length){const target=candidates[0],hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'saint-predator',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,
+     {projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target,weaponId:'saint-predator'});
+    damageEnemy(target.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});missiles.splice(i,1);
+   }else if(b.age>=s.duration-1e-8)missiles.splice(i,1);
+  }
+ }
+ function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
+  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='saint-predator');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
+  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(delta<=0)return;
+  let left=delta;
+  while(left>1e-8){
+   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,viewport);const stats=saintPredatorLevelStats(weapon.level);
+    cooldown=attackTimeFormula(stats.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
+   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);advance(step,player);cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);left-=step;
+  }
+ }
+ function draw(context,camera){context.save();for(const b of missiles){

+ }context.restore();}

+import {tuningPerk,slowdownTuningSettings} from './tuning-parts.js';
+import {damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
+/** Temporary movement reduction, independent of permanent speed and knockback. */
+export function applySlowdown(enemy,percent,seconds=5){
+  if(enemy.hp<=0||!(percent>0)||!(seconds>0))return false;
+  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0,seconds);
+  enemy.slowdownPercent=percent;return true;
+}
+export function updateSlowdown(enemy,delta){
+  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
+  if(enemy.slowdownRemaining<1e-6){enemy.slowdownRemaining=0;enemy.slowdownPercent=0;}
+}
+export function slowdownMultiplier(enemy){return enemy.slowdownRemaining>0?1-Math.min(100,Math.max(0,enemy.slowdownPercent||0))/100:1;}
+
+/** Single bonus hit; does not recursively trigger itself or repeatedly tick. */
+export function trySlowdownTuningHit({player,enemy,rollDamage,random=Math.random}){
+  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
+  if(main!=='plana-umbrella'||!player.tuningParts||enemy.hp<=0)return false;
+  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowChance');if(!chance||random()>=chance)return false;
+  if(!applySlowdown(enemy,tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowPercent'),slowdownTuningSettings.seconds))return false;
+  const hit=rollDamage(enemy,tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowDamagePercent')/100);
+  damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{slowdownTuning:true});return true;
+}

+import {stunnedFrames} from './stunned-animation.js';
+import {loadGifAnimation,gifFrameAt} from './gif-animation.js';
+import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
+export const stunnedSettings={testSeconds:3,source:'../sprites/icons/effects/stunned.gif',headGap:2,headInset:.35};
+const animation={gifFrames:stunnedFrames};
+export const stunnedReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():loadGifAnimation(animation);
+export function applyStunned(enemy,seconds=stunnedSettings.testSeconds){
+  if(!(seconds>0)||enemy.hp===0)return false;
+  if(!(enemy.stunRemaining>0))enemy.stunVisualElapsed=0;
+  enemy.stunRemaining=Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining||0,seconds);enemy.moving=false;return true;
+}
+export function stunVisibleEnemies(enemies,camera,width,height){
+  let count=0;for(const enemy of enemies){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
+    if(body.x+body.rx<camera.x||body.x-body.rx>camera.x+width||body.y+body.ry<camera.y||body.y-body.ry>camera.y+height)continue;
+    if(applyStunned(enemy))count++;
+  }return count;
+}
+export function drawStunnedStatus(context,camera,enemy){
+  if(!(enemy.stunRemaining>0)||enemy.hp===0||!animation.animationFrames?.length)return;
+  const stars=animation.animationFrames[gifFrameAt(animation.animationFrames,(enemy.stunVisualElapsed||0)*1000)].image;
+  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),width=Math.max(32,Math.min(140,body.rx*1.6)),height=width*stars.naturalHeight/stars.naturalWidth;
+  context.save();context.drawImage(stars,body.x-camera.x-width/2,body.y-camera.y-body.ry+body.ry*2*stunnedSettings.headInset-stunnedSettings.headGap-height,width,height);context.restore();
+}
+export function createStunnedAdmin({root,getEnemies,getCamera,getSize}){
+  const status=root.querySelector('[role="status"]');
+  root.querySelector('#admin-stun-visible').addEventListener('click',()=>{const {width,height}=getSize();const count=stunVisibleEnemies(getEnemies(),getCamera(),width,height);status.textContent=`Stunned ${count} onscreen enemies for 3 seconds.`;});
+}

+import {superSynergyRecipes} from './super-synergy-recipes.js';
+export const superSynergySettings={minimumLevel:50,synergyThreshold:3,maxCrafts:1};
+export function createSuperSynergyRun(){return {hammer:'none',hammerCreated:false,crafted:false,groundPosition:null,adminHammerPieces:0};}
+export const superSynergyRun=createSuperSynergyRun();
+export function superSynergyProgress(player,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
+  if(state.crafted)return {stage:'complete',frame:null};
+  const weapons=(player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean),count=weapons.filter(w=>w.isSynergy&&!w.isSuperSynergy).length;
+  const eligible=recipes.some(recipe=>weapons.some(w=>w.id===recipe.synergyId));
+  if(state.hammer==='held')return {stage:'hammer',frame:2};
+  if(!eligible&&!state.adminHammerPieces)return {stage:'hidden',frame:null};
+  const pieces=Math.max(eligible?(count>=2?2:1):0,state.adminHammerPieces||0);
+  return {stage:pieces>=2?'shaft':'half-shaft',frame:pieces>=2?1:0,
+    earn:eligible&&!state.hammerCreated?(count>=3?'held':(player.level||1)>=50?'ground':null):null};
+}
+export function advanceSuperSynergyProgress(player,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
+  const progress=superSynergyProgress(player,state,recipes);
+  if(progress.earn){state.hammerCreated=true;state.hammer=progress.earn;}
+  return superSynergyProgress(player,state,recipes);
+}
+/** Admin-only progression shortcut: each click adds one visual stage, without changing recipes. */
+export function grantGoldenHammerPiece(player,state=superSynergyRun){
+  if(state.crafted||state.hammer!=='none')return false;
+  const current=superSynergyProgress(player,state);
+  state.adminHammerPieces=Math.min(3,Math.max(state.adminHammerPieces||0,current.frame===null?0:current.frame+1)+1);
+  if(state.adminHammerPieces>=3){state.hammer='held';state.hammerCreated=true;state.groundPosition=null;}
+  return true;
+}
+export function collectGoldenHammer(state=superSynergyRun){
+  if(state.hammer!=='ground'||state.crafted)return false;
+  state.hammer='held';state.groundPosition=null;return true;
+}
+function validItem(item,id){
+  return item&&(item.id===id||item.baseItemId===id)&&
+    (item.isSuper===true||item.super===true||item.superItem===true||(Number.isFinite(item.maxLevel)&&(item.level||1)>=item.maxLevel));
+}
+export function superSynergyChoices(player,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
+  if(state.crafted||state.hammer!=='held')return [];
+  const choices=[];for(const recipe of recipes){
+    if(!recipe.id||!recipe.result?.id||player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id===recipe.result.id))continue;
+    for(let a=0;a<Math.min(6,player.attackSlots?.length||0);a++){
+      if(player.attackSlots[a]?.id!==recipe.synergyId)continue;
+      for(let b=0;b<Math.min(6,player.equipmentSlots?.length||0);b++){
+        if(!validItem(player.equipmentSlots[b],recipe.itemId))continue;
+        choices.push({id:`super-synergy:${recipe.id}:${a}:${b}`,name:recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id,label:'Super Synnergize',kind:'super-synergy',target:recipe.result,recipe,slots:[a,6+b],disabled:false,
+          description:recipe.description||`Fuse ${player.attackSlots[a].name||recipe.synergyId} and ${player.equipmentSlots[b].name||recipe.itemId}.`});
+      }
+    }
+  }return choices;
+}
+export function applySuperSynergyChoice(player,id,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
+  const choice=superSynergyChoices(player,state,recipes).find(c=>c.id===id);
+  if(!choice)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Super Synnergy requirements are not met.'};
+  let result;try{result=choice.recipe.createWeapon?choice.recipe.createWeapon():{...choice.recipe.result};}catch{return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Super Synnergy unavailable.'};}
+  if(result?.id!==choice.recipe.result.id)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Super Synnergy unavailable.'};
+  const [weaponSlot,itemSlot]=choice.slots;
+  player.attackSlots[weaponSlot]={...result,level:result.level||1,isSynergy:true,isSuperSynergy:true,consumedWeaponIds:[...new Set([...(result.consumedWeaponIds||[]),choice.recipe.synergyId,...(player.attackSlots[weaponSlot].consumedWeaponIds||[])])],consumedItemIds:[choice.recipe.itemId]};
+  player.equipmentSlots[itemSlot-6]=null;
+  state.hammer='used';state.crafted=true;state.hammerCreated=true;state.groundPosition=null;
+  return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${result.name||result.id} created!`};
+}

+import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
+import {getEnemy,damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
+import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
+const markedProjectiles=new WeakSet();
+let icon;if(typeof Image!=='undefined'){icon=new Image();icon.src='../sprites/icons/Marker Buoy.png';}
+function enabled(player){return player.tuningParts&&((player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null))==='plana-umbrella')&&tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'targetPercent')>0;}
+/** No propagation hooks are called for transfer damage, so it can never chain recursively. */
+export function shareTargetTuningDamage({player,enemy,damage,hitType='normal'}){
+  if(!enabled(player)||!(damage>0))return 0;
+  const run=player.tuningParts,marks=run.targetMarkedIds;if(!marks?.has(enemy.id))return 0;
+  const amount=Math.round(damage*tuningPerk(run,'targetPercent')/100);if(amount<1)return 0;
+  let count=0;for(const id of [...marks]){
+    const target=getEnemy(id);if(!target){marks.delete(id);continue;}
+    if(id===enemy.id)continue;
+    if(damageEnemy(id,amount,player,hitType,{targetTransfer:true}))count++;
+  }return count;
+}
+export function onTargetTuningHit({player,projectile,enemy,damage,hitType}){
+  if(!enabled(player))return;
+  if(!markedProjectiles.has(projectile)){
+    markedProjectiles.add(projectile);player.tuningParts.targetMarkedIds??=new Set();player.tuningParts.targetMarkedIds.add(enemy.id);
+  }
+  shareTargetTuningDamage({player,enemy,damage,hitType});
+}
+export function drawTargetTuningMark(context,camera,enemy,player){
+  if(!enabled(player)||!player.tuningParts.targetMarkedIds?.has(enemy.id)||enemy.hp<=0||!icon?.naturalWidth)return;
+  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),size=22;
+  context.save();context.globalAlpha=.85;context.drawImage(icon,body.x-camera.x-size/2,body.y-camera.y-body.ry-size-4,size,size);context.restore();
+}

+﻿const assert=require('node:assert/strict'),fs=require('node:fs'),vm=require('node:vm');
+const source=fs.readFileSync('Development/dev-session.js','utf8');
+const store=new Map();
+function page(){
+ const input={id:'disable-autoattack',type:'checkbox',value:'on',checked:false,dispatchEvent(){this.applied=true}};
+ const document={querySelectorAll(s){return s.startsWith('.test-toolbar')?[input]:[]},querySelector(){return null},addEventListener(){}};
+ class Socket{constructor(){this.listeners=[]}addEventListener(type,fn){this.listeners.push(fn)}sendReload(data='reload'){this.listeners.forEach(fn=>fn({data}))}}
+ const c={location:{pathname:'/Development/movement.html'},Date,Event,document,sessionStorage:{getItem:k=>store.get(k),setItem:(k,v)=>store.set(k,v),removeItem:k=>store.delete(k)},WebSocket:Socket};c.window=c;vm.runInNewContext(source,c);return {c,input};
+}
+let a=page();a.input.checked=true;new a.c.WebSocket().sendReload();
+let b=page();b.c.restoreDevSession();assert.equal(b.input.checked,true);assert(b.input.applied);
+let manual=page();manual.c.restoreDevSession();assert.equal(manual.input.checked,false);assert.equal(store.size,0);
+a=page();a.input.checked=true;new a.c.WebSocket().sendReload(JSON.stringify({type:'full-reload'}));b=page();b.c.restoreDevSession();assert(b.input.checked);
+store.set('orbitrail:dev-settings:/Development/movement.html:code-reload',JSON.stringify(Date.now()-20000));manual=page();manual.c.restoreDevSession();assert.equal(manual.input.checked,false);
+console.log('PASS: Live Server/Vite reloads restore settings; manual refresh and stale signals reset.');

+import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
+export const trumpetTuningSettings={source:'../Audio/SFX/why.mp3'};
+const lastDoot=new WeakMap(),voices=new Set(),voiceGains=new WeakMap(),boundSliders=new WeakSet(),boostNodes=new WeakMap();let clock=0,volume=1,audioContext;
+export function updateTrumpetTuning(delta){clock+=Math.max(0,delta);}
+/** Independent voices overlap and finish naturally; no pause/reset/restart on another shot. */
+export function playTrumpetTuning(player,weaponId='plana-umbrella'){
+  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null),run=player.tuningParts;
+  if(weaponId!==main||!run||typeof Audio==='undefined')return false;
+  const frames=tuningPerk(run,'dootCooldownFrames');if(!frames||clock-(lastDoot.get(run)??-Infinity)<frames/60-1e-8)return false;
+  lastDoot.set(run,clock);
+  const voice=new Audio(trumpetTuningSettings.source);voice.loop=false;voiceGains.set(voice,tuningPerk(run,'dootVolume'));voice.volume=Math.min(1,voiceGains.get(voice))*volume;voices.add(voice);
+  if(voiceGains.get(voice)>1){
+    const Context=globalThis.AudioContext||globalThis.webkitAudioContext;
+    if(Context)try{
+      audioContext??=new Context();
+      if(audioContext.state==='suspended')audioContext.resume()?.catch(()=>{});
+      const source=audioContext.createMediaElementSource(voice),gain=audioContext.createGain();
+      gain.gain.value=voiceGains.get(voice);source.connect(gain);gain.connect(audioContext.destination);boostNodes.set(voice,{source,gain});
+    }catch{}
+  }
+  const finished=()=>{voices.delete(voice);const nodes=boostNodes.get(voice);if(nodes){nodes.source.disconnect();nodes.gain.disconnect();boostNodes.delete(voice);}};voice.addEventListener('ended',finished,{once:true});voice.addEventListener('error',finished,{once:true});
+  try{const playing=voice.play();playing?.catch(finished);}catch{finished();}
+  return true;
+}
+export function trumpetVoiceCount(){return voices.size;}
+
+/** Match the existing volume control, including voices already ringing out. */
+export function setTrumpetVolume(value){
+  volume=Number.isFinite(value)?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,value)):0;
+  for(const voice of voices)voice.volume=Math.min(1,voiceGains.get(voice))*volume;
+}
+export function bindTrumpetVolume(slider){
+  if(!slider||boundSliders.has(slider))return;
+  boundSliders.add(slider);const sync=()=>setTrumpetVolume(Number(slider.value)/100);
+  slider.addEventListener('input',sync);sync();
+}

+import {tuningPartCatalog,tuningPartSettings,tuningPartMaxLevel,tuningPartLevelLabel} from './tuning-parts.js';
+/** Manual test drops bypass random odds and run exclusions, without changing natural drops. */
+export function createTuningAdmin({root,getPlayer,system}) {
+  const buttons=root.querySelector('#admin-tuning-buttons'),level=root.querySelector('#admin-tuning-level');
+  const status=root.querySelector('#admin-tuning-status');buttons.replaceChildren();
+  for(const part of tuningPartCatalog){
+    const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.textContent=`Spawn ${part.name}`;
+    button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
+      const requested=Number(level.value);if(!Number.isInteger(requested)||requested<1||requested>tuningPartSettings.maxLevel)return;
+      const rank=Math.min(requested,tuningPartMaxLevel(part));
+      const player=getPlayer(),drop=system.spawn(player.x+80,player.y,{id:part.id,level:rank});
+      status.textContent=drop?`${part.name} ${tuningPartLevelLabel({id:part.id,level:rank})} spawned near the player.`:'No safe ground available for this drop.';
+    });buttons.append(button);
+  }
+}

+import {tryWeakTuningHit} from './weak-tuning.js';
+import {trySlowdownTuningHit} from './slowdown-tuning.js';
+import {tryNeutralizationHit} from './neutralization-tuning.js';
+import {shareTargetTuningDamage} from './target-tuning.js';
+import {tryRepairTuningHit} from './repair-tuning.js';
+import {applyTuningKnockback} from './knockback-tuning.js';
+import {tryLuxeryTuningHit} from './luxery-tuning.js';
+import {tryColdTuningHit} from './cold-tuning.js';
+import {tuningPerk,explosiveTuningSettings} from './tuning-parts.js';
+import {getAllEnemies,damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
+import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
+import {drawArtilleryExplosion,artilleryExplosionDuration} from './artillery-explosion.js';
+const triggered=new WeakSet(),effects=[];
+/** One successful proc per attack/projectile; splash never re-enters this function. */
+export function tryTuningExplosion({player,projectile,enemy,rollDamage,onHit=null,random=Math.random,weaponId="plana-umbrella"}){
+  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
+  if(weaponId!==main||!player.tuningParts||triggered.has(projectile))return false;
+  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'explosionChance');if(!(chance>0)||random()>=chance)return false;
+  triggered.add(projectile);
+  const center=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),zone={x:center.x,y:center.y,radius:explosiveTuningSettings.radius,age:0};effects.push(zone);
+  for(const target of getAllEnemies()){
+    const body=getEnemyHurtbox(target);
+    if(Math.hypot(body.x-zone.x,body.y-zone.y)>zone.radius+Math.max(body.rx,body.ry))continue;
+    const hit=rollDamage(target,explosiveTuningSettings.damageMultiplier,{growthEligible:false});
+    const hpBefore=target.hp;
+    const landed=damageEnemy(target.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{tuningExplosion:true,weaponId:'plana-umbrella'});
+    // Accepted splash goes through normal damage/on-hit listeners (including future Greed).
+    if(landed){if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'weakChance')>0)tryWeakTuningHit({player,enemy:target});if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowChance')>0)trySlowdownTuningHit({player,enemy:target,rollDamage:(target,multiplier)=>rollDamage(target,multiplier,{growthEligible:false})});if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'stunChance')>0)tryNeutralizationHit({player,enemy:target});if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'targetPercent')>0)shareTargetTuningDamage({player,enemy:target,damage:Math.min(hpBefore,hit.damage),hitType:hit.type});if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'repairMaxHpPercent')>0)tryRepairTuningHit({player});if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'creditChancePercent')>0)tryLuxeryTuningHit({player,enemy:target,damage:hit.damage});if(onHit)onHit(landed);else if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackFrames')>0)applyTuningKnockback(player,landed);if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'coldDamagePercent')>0)tryColdTuningHit({player,enemy:landed,rollDamage:(target,multiplier)=>rollDamage(target,multiplier,{growthEligible:false})});}
+  }
+  return true;
+}
+export function updateTuningExplosions(delta){for(let i=effects.length-1;i>=0;i--){effects[i].age+=delta;if(effects[i].age>=artilleryExplosionDuration)effects.splice(i,1);}}
+export function drawTuningExplosions(context,camera){for(const effect of effects)drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,effect,effect.age);}
+export function clearTuningExplosions(){effects.length=0;}

+export const explosiveTuningSettings = {radius:48,damageMultiplier:.3};
+export const tuningPartSettings = {dropChance:1/780,slots:3,maxLevel:3,groundSize:64,lightOffsetY:8,pillarHeight:60};
+export function createTuningRun(){return {equipped:[null,null,null],excluded:new Set()};}
+export function eligibleTuningParts(run,catalog=tuningPartCatalog){return catalog.filter(p=>!run.excluded.has(p.id)&&!run.equipped.some(e=>e?.id===p.id));}
+export function rollTuningPart(run,enemy,random=Math.random,catalog=tuningPartCatalog,bonusChance=0){
+  const extra=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,bonusChance)),chance=extra?1-(1-tuningPartSettings.dropChance)*(1-extra):tuningPartSettings.dropChance;
+  if(enemy.type!=='yuuka'&&random()>=chance)return null;
+  const pool=eligibleTuningParts(run,catalog);if(!pool.length)return null;
+  const weight=part=>Math.max(0,part.weight??1),total=pool.reduce((sum,part)=>sum+weight(part),0);
+  if(!total)return null;
+  let pick=Math.min(1-Number.EPSILON,Math.max(0,random()))*total;
+  for(const part of pool){pick-=weight(part);if(pick<0)return {id:part.id,level:1};}
+  return null;
+}
+export function equipTuningPart(run,part,index){
+  if(!part||!Number.isInteger(part.level)||part.level<1||part.level>tuningPartMaxLevel(part)||!Number.isInteger(index)||index<0||index>=3||run.equipped.some((p,i)=>i!==index&&p?.id===part.id))return {ok:false};
+  const previous=run.equipped[index];run.equipped[index]={...part};return {ok:true,previous};
+}
+export function tuningPartMaxLevel(part,catalog=tuningPartCatalog){
+  const id=typeof part==='string'?part:part?.id,definition=catalog.find(item=>item.id===id);
+  return definition?.maxLevel??definition?.levels.length??tuningPartSettings.maxLevel;
+}
+/** Shared firing/damage split count for future ranged Multishot starting weapons. */
+export function startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,weaponId,baseCount=1){

+  const eligible=weaponId===main&&weapon?.ranged!==false&&String(weapon?.attackType).toLowerCase()==='multishot';
+  return Math.max(1,baseCount)+(eligible&&player.tuningParts?tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'extraProjectiles'):0);

+export function strengthenTuningPart(run,consumed,index){
+  const target=run.equipped[index];if(!target||!consumed||target===consumed||target.level>=tuningPartMaxLevel(target))return false;
+  target.level++;run.excluded.add(consumed.id);return true;
+}
+export function tuningSellValue(part,player,catalog=tuningPartCatalog){
+  const definition=catalog.find(p=>p.id===part.id),base=definition?.sellCredits?.[part.level-1];
+  return Number.isFinite(base)?Math.floor(base*(player.stageCoinMultiplier??1)*(1+(player.moneyUpBonus||0)/100)):null;
+}
+/** Starting-weapon effects only; consumers request a perk explicitly, never alter character stats. */
+export function tuningPerk(run,key,catalog=tuningPartCatalog){return run.equipped.reduce((sum,part)=>sum+(Number(catalog.find(p=>p.id===part?.id)?.levels?.[(part?.level||1)-1]?.[key])||0),0);}

+/** Reverse Tuning now flips the wielder only; retained aim hook never changes attacks. */
+export function startingWeaponAim(player,weaponId,angle){return angle;}
+export function reverseTuningUpsideDown(player){

+}

+import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
+export function weakenedAttackMultiplier(enemy){return enemy?.weakRemaining>0?1-(enemy.weakAttackPercent||0)/100:1;}
+export function updateWeakTuning(enemy,delta){
+  enemy.weakRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.weakRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
+  if(enemy.weakRemaining<1e-6){enemy.weakRemaining=0;enemy.weakAttackPercent=0;enemy.weakDefensePercent=0;}
+}
+export function tryWeakTuningHit({player,enemy,random=Math.random}){
+  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
+  if(main!=='plana-umbrella'||!player.tuningParts||enemy.hp<=0)return false;
+  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'weakChance');if(!chance||random()>=chance)return false;
+  enemy.weakRemaining=3;enemy.weakAttackPercent=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'weakAttackPercent');enemy.weakDefensePercent=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'weakDefensePercent');return true;
+}

+(() => {
+  const manual=document.currentScript.hasAttribute('data-game-loading');
+  let completed=0,total=1,loaded=false,finished=false,screen,bar,label;
+  const tasks=new Set();
+  function render() {
+    const percent=finished?100:Math.min(95,Math.round(completed/Math.max(1,total)*95));
+    if(bar){bar.style.width=percent+'%';screen.setAttribute('aria-valuenow',percent);label.textContent=percent+'%';}
+  }
+  function track(promise) {
+    total++;const task=Promise.resolve(promise);tasks.add(task);render();
+    task.then(settle,settle);
+    function settle(){completed++;tasks.delete(task);render();if(loaded&&!manual&&!tasks.size)finish();}
+    return task;
+  }
+  function finish() {
+    if(finished)return;finished=true;render();
+    if(screen){screen.classList.add('is-ready');setTimeout(()=>screen.remove(),350);}
+  }
+  function fail(message) {
+    if(!screen)return;
+    screen.querySelector('.loading-caption').textContent=message||'Unable to load. Please reload to try again.';
+    const button=document.createElement('button');button.textContent='Reload';button.onclick=()=>location.reload();screen.append(button);
+  }
+  window.pageLoading={track,finish,fail};
+  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
+    screen=document.createElement('div');screen.className='archive-loading';
+    screen.setAttribute('role','progressbar');screen.setAttribute('aria-label','Loading page');screen.setAttribute('aria-valuemin','0');screen.setAttribute('aria-valuemax','100');
+    screen.innerHTML='<div class="loading-grid"></div><div class="loading-emblem" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><div class="loading-brand">OPERATION <strong>ORBITRAIL</strong></div><div class="loading-bottom"><div class="loading-heading"><span>NOW LOADING<span class="loading-dots">...</span></span><span class="loading-percent">0%</span></div><div class="loading-track"><div class="loading-fill"></div></div><p class="loading-caption">Connecting to S.C.H.A.L.E.</p></div>';
+    document.body.append(screen);bar=screen.querySelector('.loading-fill');label=screen.querySelector('.loading-percent');render();
+    for(const img of document.images)if(!img.complete)track(new Promise(resolve=>{img.addEventListener('load',resolve,{once:true});img.addEventListener('error',resolve,{once:true});}));
+    if(finished){screen.remove();}
+  },{once:true});
+  window.addEventListener('load',()=>{loaded=true;completed++;render();if(!manual&&!tasks.size)finish();},{once:true});
+})();

+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import numpy as np
+import matplotlib
+matplotlib.use('Agg')
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+s=Path('Development/game-config.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
+power=float(re.search(r'iroha:\{[^\n]*attackAngleExponent:([\d.]+)',s).group(1))
+angle=np.linspace(0,90,901)
+t=(angle-45)/45
+cannon=100*(.5-.5*np.sign(t)*np.abs(t)**power)
+plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':11})
+fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.5),dpi=150)
+ax.plot(angle,cannon,color='#147db3',lw=2.8,label='Cannon')
+ax.plot(angle,100-cannon,color='#d56727',lw=2.8,ls='--',label='Artillery')
+ax.axvspan(70,90,color='#7d8a96',alpha=.10)
+ax.axvline(70,color='#9ba5ad',lw=1,ls=':')
+ax.text(80,50,'Faster change\nafter 70°',ha='center',va='center',color='#54616c',fontsize=10)
+ax.scatter([45],[50],s=30,color='#54616c',zorder=5)
+ax.annotate('50% / 50%',xy=(45,50),xytext=(28,65),arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'-','color':'#7d8a96'},fontsize=10)
+ax.set(xlim=(0,90),ylim=(0,100),xlabel='Player angle from Iroha (0° = horizontal, 90° = vertical)',ylabel='Attack chance (%)',title='Iroha attack chance — current cubic curve')
+ax.set_xticks([0,10,20,30,40,45,50,60,70,80,90])
+ax.set_yticks(np.arange(0,101,10))
+ax.grid(axis='y',color='#dce2e6',lw=.7)
+ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
+ax.legend(loc='upper center',ncol=2,frameon=False,bbox_to_anchor=(.5,1))
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig('outputs/iroha-chance-curve/iroha-chance-curve.png',bbox_inches='tight')
+assert cannon[0]==100 and cannon[450]==50 and cannon[-1]==0
+print('Verified axis endpoints and 45-degree midpoint.')

+import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
+import vm from 'node:vm';
+import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
+import {Workbook,SpreadsheetFile} from '@oai/artifact-tool';
+const root=new URL('../../',import.meta.url);
+const c=vm.createContext({});
+for(const name of ['game-config','campaign-config','event-config','seeded-events']) {
+ const code=await fs.readFile(new URL(`Development/${name}.js`,root),'utf8');
+ vm.runInContext(code.replace(/^import .*;\r?\n/gm,'').replace(/^export \{.*\} from .*;\r?\n/gm,'').replaceAll('export ',''),c);
+}
+const data=vm.runInContext('({rows:campaignEnemyRows,events:campaignEventChart,endless:endlessEnemySettings,generated:seededEventSettings})',c);
+const names={mob:'Mob1',mob2:'Mob2',mob3:'Mob3',megaMob:'Mega Mob',megaMob3:'Mega Mob3',pedrozilla:'Pedrozilla',whiteSweeper:'Sweeper',heavySweeper:'Heavy Sweeper',opsSweeper:'OPS Sweeper',megaSweeper:'Mega Sweeper',megaHeavySweeper:'Mega Heavy Sweeper',megaOpsSweeper:'Mega OPS Sweeper',shiroko:'Shiroko',arisu:'Arisu',iroha:'Iroha',neru:'Neru',megaPedrozilla:'Mega Pedrozilla',midori:'Midori'};
+const label=id=>names[id]||id.replace(/(arius|highlander)(\d)/,(_,t,n)=>`${t==='arius'?'Arius':'Highlander'} Student${n}`).replace(/megaArius(\d)/,'Mega Arius Student$1');
+const stage=id=>({first:'Stage 1',second:'Stage 2',third:'Stage 3',fourth:'Stage 4'})[id]||id;
+const time=s=>Number.isFinite(s)?`${String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(Math.floor(s%60)).padStart(2,'0')}`:'';
+const records=[];
+for(const r of data.rows) {
+ let notes=r.freeze?'Freezes internal clock until required encounters are defeated. ':'';
+ if(r.id==='s1-shiroko')notes+='Normal chase. Defeat advances to Stage 2 after 1.5s.';
+ if(r.id==='s2-arisu')notes+='4s windup; aim locks at 3s; 1375px/s dash; 20 damage; 1.5s braking. Arisu and OPS checkpoint both required.';
+ if(r.id==='s2-mega-ops')notes+='After Arisu and this encounter die, clock resumes through 14:00 before Stage 3.';
+ if(r.stage==='first'&&r.end>360&&Number.isFinite(r.end))notes+=' Stage 1 clock freezes at 06:00; listed window end is not reached.';
+ records.push({sort:r.start,values:[stage(r.stage),time(r.start),time(r.end),r.kind==='regular'?'Regular spawn window':r.kind==='mini'?'Mini-boss':'Boss',r.enemies.map(label).join(', '),r.kind==='regular'?'Chase':'Encounter',r.kind==='regular'?'Stream':1,'','',r.hp,r.atk,r.spd,r.exp,notes.trim()]});
+}
+for(const e of data.events) {
+ const types=Array.isArray(e.enemy)?e.enemy:[e.enemy];
+ for(const type of types){c.inputEvent=e;c.inputType=type;const p=vm.runInContext('eventEnemyProfile(inputEvent,inputType,inputEvent.timeSeconds,inputEvent.stage)',c);
+ let notes='Starts offscreen.';
+ if(e.repeatForLifetime)notes+=' All rings expire together at event lifetime end.';
+ if(e.spawnDuration)notes+=` Formation released over ${e.spawnDuration}s.`;
+ if(e.timeSeconds===810)notes+=' Runs only after Stage 2 boss checkpoint unfreezes the internal clock.';
+ records.push({sort:e.timeSeconds,values:[stage(e.stage),time(e.timeSeconds),time(e.endTimeSeconds), 'Timed event',label(type),e.pattern,e.count,e.repeatSeconds||'',e.lifetimeSeconds??'',p.hp,p.atk,p.spd,p.exp,notes]});}
+}
+for(const type of data.endless.enemies)records.push({sort:1380,values:['Endless',time(1380),'','Endless pool',label(type),'Mega variant','Stream','','',5000,15,1,25,'Base values; later time scaling applies. Endless progression requires Stage 4 clear.']});
+records.push({sort:1800,values:['Endless','30:00','','Endless pool','Midori','Chase','Stream','','',9000,5,1.5,25,'Joins endless enemy pool at internal 30:00.']});
+records.push({sort:1020,values:['Stages 3–4 / Endless','17:00','','Generated events','Eligible current enemy pool',data.generated.patterns.join(', '),'12–60 (cluster: 20)','35–55','14–24','','','','','Seeded generation begins after 25 active seconds past 17:00. Interval uses active gameplay time, not a fixed chart timestamp.']});
+records.sort((a,b)=>a.sort-b.sort||a.values[0].localeCompare(b.values[0]));
+const headers=['Stage','Start (internal mm:ss)','End (internal mm:ss)','Type','Enemy','Pattern','Amount','Repeat (seconds)','Lifetime (seconds)','HP','ATK','SPD (base-player ratio)','EXP','Notes'];
+const matrix=[headers,...records.map(r=>r.values)];
+const wb=Workbook.create(),sheet=wb.worksheets.add('Game timeline');
+sheet.getRange(`A1:N${matrix.length}`).values=matrix;
+sheet.getRange(`A1:N${matrix.length}`).format.font={name:'Calibri',size:11};
+sheet.getRange('A1:N1').format.fill='#DCEAF4';
+sheet.getRange('A1:N1').format.font={bold:true};
+sheet.getRange('A1:N1').format.rowHeight=34;
+sheet.getRange(`A2:N${matrix.length}`).format.rowHeight=46;
+sheet.getRange(`A1:N${matrix.length}`).format.wrapText=true;
+for(let i=0;i<records.length;i++)if(records[i].values[3]==='Generated events')sheet.getRange(`A${i+2}:N${i+2}`).format.rowHeight=150;
+const widths=[120,135,135,155,225,150,125,105,110,85,65,125,85,520];
+for(let i=0;i<widths.length;i++)sheet.getRange(`${String.fromCharCode(65+i)}1:${String.fromCharCode(65+i)}${matrix.length}`).format.columnWidth=widths[i]/7;
+sheet.getRange(`N2:N${matrix.length}`).format.font={size:10};
+sheet.freezePanes.freezeRows(1);
+sheet.freezePanes.freezeColumns(2);
+sheet.showGridLines=true;
+wb.recalculate();
+console.log(JSON.stringify({campaignRows:data.rows.length,eventRows:data.events.length,outputRows:records.length,stage2Boss:matrix.find(r=>r[4]==='Arisu')}));
+const preview=await wb.render({sheetName:'Game timeline',range:'A1:N13',scale:1,format:'png'});
+await fs.writeFile(new URL('preview.png',import.meta.url),new Uint8Array(await preview.arrayBuffer()));
+const output=await SpreadsheetFile.exportXlsx(wb);await output.save(fileURLToPath(new URL('Game_Timeline.xlsx',import.meta.url)));

+# `@img/colour`
+
+The latest version of the
+[color](https://www.npmjs.com/package/color)
+package is now ESM-only,
+however some JavaScript runtimes do not yet support this,
+which includes versions of Node.js prior to 20.19.0.
+
+This package converts the `color` package and its dependencies,
+all of which are MIT-licensed, to CommonJS.
+
+- [color](https://www.npmjs.com/package/color)
+- [color-convert](https://www.npmjs.com/package/color-convert)
+- [color-string](https://www.npmjs.com/package/color-string)
+- [color-name](https://www.npmjs.com/package/color-name)

+convert.rgb.hsl = function(rgb) {
+  const r = rgb[0] / 255;
+  const g = rgb[1] / 255;
+  const b = rgb[2] / 255;
+  const min = Math.min(r, g, b);
+  const max = Math.max(r, g, b);
+  const delta = max - min;
+  let h;
+  let s;
+  switch (max) {
+    case min: {
+      h = 0;
+      break;
+    }
+    case r: {
+      h = (g - b) / delta;
+      break;
+    }
+    case g: {
+      h = 2 + (b - r) / delta;
+      break;
+    }
+    case b: {
+      h = 4 + (r - g) / delta;
+      break;
+    }
+  }
+  h = Math.min(h * 60, 360);
+  if (h < 0) {
+    h += 360;
+  }
+  const l = (min + max) / 2;
+  if (max === min) {
+    s = 0;
+  } else if (l <= 0.5) {
+    s = delta / (max + min);
+  } else {
+    s = delta / (2 - max - min);
+  }
+  return [h, s * 100, l * 100];

+convert.rgb.hsv = function(rgb) {
+  let rdif;
+  let gdif;
+  let bdif;
+  let h;
+  let s;
+  const r = rgb[0] / 255;
+  const g = rgb[1] / 255;
+  const b = rgb[2] / 255;
+  const v = Math.max(r, g, b);
+  const diff = v - Math.min(r, g, b);
+  const diffc = function(c) {
+    return (v - c) / 6 / diff + 1 / 2;
+  };
+  if (diff === 0) {
+    h = 0;
+    s = 0;
+  } else {
+    s = diff / v;
+    rdif = diffc(r);
+    gdif = diffc(g);
+    bdif = diffc(b);
+    switch (v) {
+      case r: {
+        h = bdif - gdif;
+        break;
+      }
+      case g: {
+        h = 1 / 3 + rdif - bdif;
+        break;
+      }
+      case b: {
+        h = 2 / 3 + gdif - rdif;
+        break;
+      }
+    }
+    if (h < 0) {
+      h += 1;
+    } else if (h > 1) {
+      h -= 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return [
+    h * 360,
+    s * 100,
+    v * 100
+  ];
+};

+convert.hsl.rgb = function(hsl) {
+  const h = hsl[0] / 360;
+  const s = hsl[1] / 100;
+  const l = hsl[2] / 100;
+  let t3;
+  let value;
+  if (s === 0) {
+    value = l * 255;
+    return [value, value, value];
+  }
+  const t2 = l < 0.5 ? l * (1 + s) : l + s - l * s;
+  const t1 = 2 * l - t2;
+  const rgb = [0, 0, 0];
+  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
+    t3 = h + 1 / 3 * -(i - 1);
+    if (t3 < 0) {
+      t3++;
+    }
+    if (t3 > 1) {
+      t3--;
+    }
+    if (6 * t3 < 1) {
+      value = t1 + (t2 - t1) * 6 * t3;
+    } else if (2 * t3 < 1) {
+      value = t2;
+    } else if (3 * t3 < 2) {
+      value = t1 + (t2 - t1) * (2 / 3 - t3) * 6;
+    } else {
+      value = t1;
+    }
+    rgb[i] = value * 255;
+  }
+  return rgb;

+convert.hsl.hsv = function(hsl) {

+  smin *= lmin <= 1 ? lmin : 2 - lmin;

+convert.hsv.rgb = function(hsv) {

+    case 0: {
+      return [v, t, p];
+    }
+    case 1: {
+      return [q, v, p];
+    }
+    case 2: {
+      return [p, v, t];
+    }
+    case 3: {
+      return [p, q, v];
+    }
+    case 4: {
+      return [t, p, v];
+    }
+    case 5: {
+      return [v, p, q];
+    }
+  }
+};
+convert.hsv.hsl = function(hsv) {

+    bl /= ratio;
+  }
+  const i = Math.floor(6 * h);
+  const v = 1 - bl;
+  f = 6 * h - i;
+  if ((i & 1) !== 0) {
+    f = 1 - f;
+  }
+  const n = wh + f * (v - wh);
+  let r;
+  let g;
+  let b;
+  switch (i) {
+    default:
+    case 6:
+    case 0: {
+      r = v;
+      g = n;
+      b = wh;
+      break;
+    }
+    case 1: {
+      r = n;
+      g = v;
+      b = wh;
+      break;
+    }
+    case 2: {
+      r = wh;
+      g = v;
+      b = n;
+      break;
+    }
+    case 3: {
+      r = wh;
+      g = n;
+      b = v;
+      break;
+    }
+    case 4: {
+      r = n;
+      g = wh;
+      b = v;
+      break;
+    }
+    case 5: {
+      r = v;
+      g = wh;
+      b = n;
+      break;
+    }
+  }
+  return [r * 255, g * 255, b * 255];
+};
+convert.cmyk.rgb = function(cmyk) {
+  const c = cmyk[0] / 100;
+  const m = cmyk[1] / 100;
+  const y = cmyk[2] / 100;
+  const k = cmyk[3] / 100;
+  const r = 1 - Math.min(1, c * (1 - k) + k);
+  const g = 1 - Math.min(1, m * (1 - k) + k);
+  const b = 1 - Math.min(1, y * (1 - k) + k);
+  return [r * 255, g * 255, b * 255];
+};
+convert.xyz.rgb = function(xyz) {
+  const x = xyz[0] / 100;
+  const y = xyz[1] / 100;
+  const z = xyz[2] / 100;
+  let r;
+  let g;
+  let b;
+  r = x * 3.2404542 + y * -1.5371385 + z * -0.4985314;
+  g = x * -0.969266 + y * 1.8760108 + z * 0.041556;
+  b = x * 0.0556434 + y * -0.2040259 + z * 1.0572252;
+  r = srgbNonlinearTransform(r);
+  g = srgbNonlinearTransform(g);
+  b = srgbNonlinearTransform(b);
+  return [r * 255, g * 255, b * 255];
+};
+convert.xyz.lab = function(xyz) {
+  let x = xyz[0];
+  let y = xyz[1];
+  let z = xyz[2];
+  x /= 95.047;
+  y /= 100;
+  z /= 108.883;
+  x = x > LAB_FT ? x ** (1 / 3) : 7.787 * x + 16 / 116;
+  y = y > LAB_FT ? y ** (1 / 3) : 7.787 * y + 16 / 116;
+  z = z > LAB_FT ? z ** (1 / 3) : 7.787 * z + 16 / 116;
+  const l = 116 * y - 16;
+  const a = 500 * (x - y);
+  const b = 200 * (y - z);
+  return [l, a, b];
+};
+convert.xyz.oklab = function(xyz) {

+  const mp = Math.cbrt(0.0329845436 * x + 0.9293118715 * y + 0.0361456387 * z);
+  const sp = Math.cbrt(0.0482003018 * x + 0.2643662691 * y + 0.633851707 * z);
+  const l = 0.2104542553 * lp + 0.793617785 * mp - 0.0040720468 * sp;
+  const a = 1.9779984951 * lp - 2.428592205 * mp + 0.4505937099 * sp;
+  const b = 0.0259040371 * lp + 0.7827717662 * mp - 0.808675766 * sp;
+  return [l * 100, a * 100, b * 100];

+  const s = (1.000000055 * ll - 0.089484182 * a - 1.291485538 * b) ** 3;

+convert.oklab.rgb = function(oklab) {

+  const s = (ll - 0.0894841775 * aa - 1.291485548 * bb) ** 3;
+  const r = srgbNonlinearTransform(4.0767416621 * l - 3.3077115913 * m + 0.2309699292 * s);
+  const g = srgbNonlinearTransform(-1.2684380046 * l + 2.6097574011 * m - 0.3413193965 * s);
+  const b = srgbNonlinearTransform(-0.0041960863 * l - 0.7034186147 * m + 1.707614701 * s);

+convert.lab.xyz = function(lab) {
+  const l = lab[0];
+  const a = lab[1];
+  const b = lab[2];
+  let x;
+  let y;
+  let z;
+  y = (l + 16) / 116;
+  x = a / 500 + y;
+  z = y - b / 200;
+  const y2 = y ** 3;
+  const x2 = x ** 3;
+  const z2 = z ** 3;
+  y = y2 > LAB_FT ? y2 : (y - 16 / 116) / 7.787;
+  x = x2 > LAB_FT ? x2 : (x - 16 / 116) / 7.787;
+  z = z2 > LAB_FT ? z2 : (z - 16 / 116) / 7.787;
+  x *= 95.047;
+  y *= 100;
+  z *= 108.883;
+  return [x, y, z];
+};
+convert.lab.lch = function(lab) {
+  const l = lab[0];
+  const a = lab[1];
+  const b = lab[2];
+  let h;
+  const hr = Math.atan2(b, a);
+  h = hr * 360 / 2 / Math.PI;
+  if (h < 0) {
+    h += 360;
+  }
+  const c = Math.sqrt(a * a + b * b);
+  return [l, c, h];
+};
+convert.lch.lab = function(lch) {
+  const l = lch[0];
+  const c = lch[1];
+  const h = lch[2];
+  const hr = h / 360 * 2 * Math.PI;
+  const a = c * Math.cos(hr);
+  const b = c * Math.sin(hr);
+  return [l, a, b];
+};
+convert.rgb.ansi16 = function(args, saturation = null) {
+  const [r, g, b] = args;
+  let value = saturation === null ? convert.rgb.hsv(args)[2] : saturation;
+  value = Math.round(value / 50);
+  if (value === 0) {
+    return 30;
+  }
+  let ansi = 30 + (Math.round(b / 255) << 2 | Math.round(g / 255) << 1 | Math.round(r / 255));
+  if (value === 2) {
+    ansi += 60;
+  }
+  return ansi;
+};
